summary: Frontend-only test of MyMoviesPage refactor (Diary/Watchlist client filter + Add modals, Profile 'You can't get enough of...' section with reshuffle). All 13 checklist items PASS. Logged in as vibetest2, navigated to /my-movies, verified: (1) diary-search-input is client-side filter — 0 TMDB requests, case-insensitive substring match narrows to 1 item for 'inception' and 'MOANA', diary-clear-filter X restores full list (5 items). (2) open-add-diary-btn opens Radix dialog add-to-diary-dialog; TMDB search fires exactly 1 request for 'Interstellar' returning 8 results; picking a result reveals rating slider + date + comment form; cancel closes dialog. (3) Dupe protection: searching 'Inception' shows 1 'In diary' badge and that result is disabled (1/8 disabled). (4) Watchlist filter identical behavior — 0 TMDB calls, 'dark' narrows watchlist to 1 item. (5) open-add-watchlist-btn opens add-to-watchlist-dialog with TMDB search (8 results for 'Tenet'). (6) Profile tab: 'Top 5 Favorite Movies' completely removed (0 occurrences); 'You can't get enough of...' renders 4 obsession-movie-* cards with watch count + rating captions. (7) Reshuffle verified: 5 tab switches (diary↔profile) produced 6 unique orderings/sets out of 6 snapshots. (8) Regression: Top Genres/Actors/Directors sections still render on Profile tab.
critical_code_review_comments: MyMoviesPage.js is 1810 lines — consider splitting DiaryTab/WatchlistTab/ProfileTab into separate files for maintainability.
AddToLibraryDialog.js correctly guards close-during-submit and resets state on close. Clean implementation.
